text: How the signal propagates in real world. These are real world measurements performed by mobile operator in Chile. In the case where we have a base station in an urban environment and the coverage of the base station, the so called cellular cell, is quite large. So we call it macro cell because it's a large area irradiated by the base station. And you can see here the strength of the signal that is received by users over this area, where the red area is is where you receive very strong signal. Yellow, so so, green is weaker and blue is very weak. So you can see that of course the quality of the signal that you get, very significantly depending on on where you are because of the presence of obstacles and of course the distance from the transmitter. And similarly, this is a representation real world again of the power of the received signal. In the case where there is a cellular base station that illuminates a smaller area. So the base station has been placed at a lower altitude so that the coverage. So the cell is small again in an urban environment. So similar to to this one. And this is the resulting level of power of the received signal, and.
